reports.LongName: 240094003 - Disclosure - Information Relating to the Consolidated Statement of Cash Flows - Summary of Information (Details)

rows.acquisition_containment: Business-acquisition consideration separately presented; acquired fair-value PP&E is not a cash purchase operand. No residual subtraction.

unresolved_questions: Treatment of cash construction/development and mineral-interest costs within current PP&E purchase primitive, without redefining it for coverage.
Investing operating-lease payments versus capitalized costs: destination/overlap is not allocated to the reported PP&E component; no whole-lease subtraction is supported.
No independently exhaustive intangible/software or incentive split; absence does not establish zero.

remaining_design_gates: A separate immutable exact-accession scope-evidence acceptance design is required before implementing any policy entry.
Independent mineral/lease adjustment amounts and integrated FCFF compatibility remain unproved and are not acceptance operands.

methodology_review.scope_basis: R10 identifies the PP&E successful-efforts/development/mineral-property cost basis. R12 separately reports the complete PP&E cash component and excludes noncash movements; R7 and acquisition notes separate business combinations. R14 distinguishes incurred capitalized lease costs, actual investing cash, noncash ROU additions and financing principal.
methodology_review.noncash_rou_evidence_location: R14.htm, footnote to right-of-use assets; not eligible annual cash operands.
methodology_review.reason_no_split_required_for_reported_va: A construction/service cost already within recognized cash PP&E is not an ineligible lease asset addition. Acceptance preserves the selected full PP&E cash component, without assuming any allocation of the separate lease disclosure.

methodology.basis: Reported gross cash acquisition/construction of recognized consolidated PP&E; no hypothetical pure-materials or pre-incentive reconstruction.
methodology.eligible: Cash development wells, related plant/equipment and proved mineral-property interests in the selected PP&E cost perimeter; cash construction inputs, including capitalized lease services, only as included in that reported cash component.
methodology.excluded: Expensed exploration/current dry holes; noncash ARO/ROU and unpaid additions; lease financing principal; business-combination consideration/fair-value assets; affiliate investments and separate intangibles; no proceeds netting.
methodology.reported_component_acceptance: All costs within the evidenced cash PP&E perimeter are eligible; separate mineral/lease subamounts are not needed to preserve that independently reported complete component.
methodology.separate_lease_or_mineral_equation: Not approved: exact destination/overlap amounts are not separately established; no whole-lease subtraction, inferred zero, residual or additive adjustment.
methodology.integrated_fcff_readiness: Unproved; historical value scope does not certify lease, depletion, EBIT, affiliate or timing compatibility.
